en.html:
I knew it.
How could I not?

A sight I had watched day after day.

Dreaming of recovery, I had wished that tomorrow this sight would be gone.
Fearing catastrophe, I had wished that tomorrow this sight would remain.

A scene of contradiction.
For a year, I had watched.

This figure.

Hikaru, afflicted by mineral poisoning, sick in body and mind!
